17.name: You sense something larger than even a giant takitaro!
17.description: You no longer sense anything out of the ordinary.
17.col_2: The presence looms large once more!

21.name: You sense something massive just below the surface!
21.description: You no longer sense anything out of the ordinary.

29.name: The water falls dark...
29.description: A faint glow returns to the water.

58.name: A golden figure lurks near the surface!
58.description: The golden figure has retreated to the murky depths.
58.col_2: The golden figure rises once more!

74.name: Something large has risen from the depths to feed!
74.description: You no longer sense anything out of the ordinary.
74.col_2: The large predator hungers once more!

94.name: You sense something even more terrible than Canavan in the waters before you!
94.description: You no longer sense anything out of the ordinary.

108.name: You sense a new legend might be told this day...
108.description: You no longer sense anything out of the ordinary.

124.name: You sense something deep beneath the magma...
124.description: You no longer sense anything out of the ordinary.

127.name: Something glimmers near the riverbed...
127.description: You no longer perceive anything out of the ordinary.

134.name: You sense the lord of these skies has returned...
134.description: You no longer sense anything out of the ordinary.
134.col_2: Again, you sense a humbling presence...

139.name: Lady Luck has sidled up beside you...
139.col_2: It seems Lady Luck has given you another chance!

146.name: Something wondrous this way comes...
146.description: You no longer sense anything out of the ordinary.
146.col_2: Something wondrous wends its way back!

168.name: The lake begins to radiate all the colors of the rainbow!

190.name: The stones beneath the water begin shifting hither and thither.
190.description: The stones are stationary once again.
190.col_2: The stones clatter back to life!

196.name: A massive shadow slides across the loch floor.

212.name: You see the flickering light of eyes beneath the waters.
212.col_2: The light flickers back to life!

215.name: You sense eyes staring up at you from the sandy waters...
215.description: You no longer sense anything out of the ordinary.
215.col_2: The eyes gaze at you once more!

224.name: A glimmering jade figure drifts beneath the waters.
224.description: The glimmer fades into the depths.
224.col_2: The glimmering jade figure drifts back to the surface!

232.name: A large shadow dances along the loch floor.
232.col_2: The shadow dances back into view!

237.name: The visage of a gormless-looking Roegadyn stares at you from beneath the waters.
237.description: The face vanishes back into the depths.
237.col_2: The Roegadyn faces you once more!

238.name: The ocean begins to twinkle like the stars in the sky.

239.name: A shadow evoking the Lord of the Whorl slithers across the ocean.
239.col_2: The shadow slithers back across your field of vision!

240.name: The coral begins to wriggle about on the ocean floor.

241.name: You see a metallic glint just beneath the waters.
241.col_2: You catch sight of the glint once more.

242.name: A massive boulder begins to writhe on the ocean floor.
242.col_2: The boulder begins to writhe again.

243.name: You spot a glimmer of crimson, as if a ruby has floated to the surface of the ocean.
243.col_2: The glimmer of crimson flashes into view once more.

244.name: The shadow lurking under the surface belongs to a beast spoken of only in legend.
244.col_2: The shadow emerges from the depths once again.

246.name: An aura of violent menace rises from the depths!
246.col_2: The aura of violent menace returns!

247.name: You glimpse the writhing silhouette of some vast tentacle moving just beneath the water.
247.col_2: You sense the undulating shadow once again.

248.name: You glance down into a pair of astoundingly goblin-like eyes.
248.description: You no longer feel the weight of that goblin-like gaze.
248.col_2: You feel that goblin-like glaze boring into you again.

249.name: You rub your eyes, certain you'd seen a creature with no business being out on the ocean.
249.description: The out-of-place creature has moved on...or never was.
249.col_2: The out-of-place creature is back in place.

250.name: A graceful, leafy form appears, swirling and dancing beneath the waves.
250.description: The leafy form has swept on out of sight.
250.col_2: The leafy form swirls gracefully back into view.

251.name: A dull cracking and crunching sound echoes up from the sea floor.
251.description: The crunching, cracking sounds fade into silence.
251.col_2: The cracking and crunching sounds resound in your ears once again.

259.name: A reptilian tail writhes and splashes up to the surface!
259.col_2: The splashing returns with renewed vigor!

268.name: The Font's aquatic flora undulates with sudden activity!
268.col_2: The aquatic flora undulates with activity anew!

269.name: A massive, ship-shaped silhouette darkens the waters before you.
269.description: The shadowy silhouette returns to the depths.
269.col_2: The waters are once again darkened with the ship-shaped silhouette.

270.name: A layer of ice suddenly forms upon the lake's surface!
270.col_2: The lake's surface begins to freeze once again!

285.name: A profound melancholy swells within you!
285.description: The melancholy passes as swiftly as it came...
285.col_2: You are seized by melancholy once more!

286.name: A large fin breaches the ocean surface!
286.description: The fin sinks under the surface and out of sight...
286.col_2: The fin breaches the water's surface again!

287.name: A lethal predator draws close to the ship!
287.col_2: The lethal predator draws close with renewed interest!

288.name: A strip of red and white floats under the water's surface!
288.description: You lose sight of the colorful fish...
288.col_2: You catch sight of the colorful fish again!

289.name: Something blue glitters deep under the water!

290.name: You feel hungry eyes track your every move!
290.description: The hungry thing decides to feast elsewhere...

291.name: The sea temperature rises suddenly!
291.description: The temperature of the water returns to normal...
291.col_2: The sea temperature begins to rise again!

292.name: The seaweed glimmers with a strange light!

293.name: The scent of plums rises from the waters!
293.col_2: The scent of plums wafts forth again!

302.name: An emerald glimmer flickers beneath the surface!
302.description: The emerald glimmer is no more...
302.col_2: The glimmering emerald form looms forth again!

313.name: A sinuous shadow writhes beneath the water!
313.description: You lose sight of the sinuous shadow...
313.col_2: The writhing shadow appears beneath the water once more!

315.name: A heart-shaped shadow flitters through the water!
315.description: The heart-shaped shadow fades out of sight...
315.col_2: The heart-shaped shadow flitters back into your field of vision!

321.name: You are overcome with a sudden icy chill!
321.description: Your body warms as the chill recedes...
321.col_2: The mysterious chill returns with an icy vengeance!

326.name: The surrounding air begins to crackle with lightning energy!
326.col_2: The air once again courses with lightning energy!

329.name: You sight the shadow of an enormous serpent!
329.description: The serpentine shadow winds out of sight...
329.col_2: The serpentine shadow looms once again!

332.name: A sharp, glinting form darts into view!
332.description: You lose sight of the glinting form...
332.col_2: The glinting form darts sharply back into view!

333.name: A colossal shadow lurks beneath the waves...
333.description: You lose sight of the colossal shadow...
333.col_2: The colossal shadow appears beneath the water once more!

334.name: You sense a watchful gaze from beneath the water!
334.col_2: You sense the watchful gaze fix upon you once more!

335.name: What appears to be a nearby island writhes before your eyes!
335.description: The movement you sensed must have been a trick of the light...
335.col_2: The apparent landmass once again teems with motion!

336.name: A vibrant shadow darts through the water!
336.description: The vibrance fades out of sight...
336.col_2: The vibrant shadow looms near again!

337.name: A forked form wends through the depths!
337.description: The forked form recedes from view...
337.col_2: The wending form makes a pointed return!

10021.name: You spot a massive shadow drifting along beneath the clouds.
10021.col_2: The looming shadow appears beneath the clouds once again.

10023.name: You glimpse the blurred form of some flying creature as it flashes across the sky.
10023.description: Like a living bolt of lightning, the creature flickers past and is gone.

10064.name: Something glints white beneath the water!
10064.description: The glint was all too fleeting...

10087.name: You glimpse a draconic form writhe up from the depths!
10087.description: The draconic figure fades from view...
10087.col_2: The draconic form looms forth once again!

10129.name: A pallid visage appears beneath the surface!
10129.description: The pale creature distorts and vanishes...
10129.col_2: You sight the pallid visage once more!

10143.name: A bulbous shadow appears in the water!
10143.col_2: The bulbous shadow drifts back into sight!

10151.name: A lethal-looking blue barb breaks the surface!
10151.description: The barb disappears beneath the surface...
10151.col_2: The blue barb breaks the surface once more!

10152.name: Within the glass, a large stone...writhes?
10152.description: You lose sight of the writhing stone...
10152.col_2: You see the stone move once again!

10181.name: A rock-like mass stirs beneath the ocean depths!
10181.description: You lose sight of the stirring mass...
10181.col_2: You spy the rock-like mass stirring once more!

10190.name: The glimmer of a jade figure catches your eye beneath the waters!
10190.description: The glimmer of jade fades from sight...
10190.col_2: The glimmer of jade returns to the water's surface!

10214.name: A large leafy form undulates beneath the surface!
10214.description: The leafy form recedes from view...
10214.col_2: The large form makes a leafy return to the surface!

10220.name: You spy a tiny sparkling jewel in the water!
10220.col_2: The jeweled creature darts back into view!

10223.name: A frond-like form stirs in the water!
10223.description: You lose sight of the frond-like form...
10223.col_2: The frond-like form begins to stir once more!

10226.name: A flowery, vine-like creature writhes underwater!
10226.col_2: You sight the writhing vine once again!

10228.name: What appears to be a shimmering, patterned sash flutters into view!
